takes.source_start: The second letter had been under a receipt for lamp oil.
takes.source_end: Receipts proving I had already spent both categories incorrectly.

takes.source_start: The support-assessment receipt remained beneath the brass key.
takes.source_end: Chapter one of my new life, apparently.

takes.source_start: Three copper. Bronze token. Bent lockpick. Receipts. Two letters.
takes.source_end: No Carrow.

takes.source_start: Whoever sent it had assumed the delivery clerk knew where to put me.
takes.source_end: Better than nothing.

takes.source_start: I opened the letter.
takes.source_end: Two guards already.

takes.source_start: They want somebody who can carry and stand watch without inventing problems. I lied about you.
takes.source_end: You said Halden first if Mara goes. If that is still the plan, ignore this.

takes.source_start: If you are actually serious about getting out on the road instead of talking about it in her mother's back room, write me before the end of the month.
takes.source_end: Nineteen.

takes.source_start: Before me.
takes.source_end: This should not have surprised me.

takes.source_start: Chapter 14 had already given me that much.
takes.source_end: Tavin had written from south of the city about a six-week freight job because Greg had apparently been talking about roads often enough for other people to become tired of hearing it.

takes.source_start: That felt more like me than I was comfortable admitting.
takes.source_end: That is not how rules work.

takes.source_start: I looked at the deck on the table.
takes.source_end: Tavin

takes.source_start: No dramatic closing.
takes.source_end: The freight crew would already be gone or full or both.

takes.source_start: I felt an immediate urge to calculate whether I could catch them.
takes.source_end: The boy had wanted this.

takes.source_start: Not exactly this life.
takes.source_end: I had spent weeks worrying that I was replacing nineteen-year-old Greg with a more competent ghost.

takes.source_start: An older man wearing his body and explaining every preference afterward as experience.
takes.source_end: Road work he had not yet taken.

takes.source_start: A cheap sword he loved enough to split kindling with.
takes.source_end: I had no idea whether Tavin still considered it owed.

takes.source_start: That was not the point.
takes.source_end: Tavin's letter did not require that much dignity.

takes.source_start: I wrote:
takes.source_end: I have the old deck. The seven is still burned. I maintain that this damages the evidence.

takes.source_start: Then:
takes.source_end: Start there.

takes.source_start: If Venn's office still gets your mail, write back when you have time.
takes.source_end: Current Greg almost needed to relearn it.

takes.source_start: I wrote beneath the signature:
takes.source_end: Company packet goes south tomorrow. Three copper.

takes.source_start: Three.
takes.source_end: I had now spent three of them sending a letter to a man I barely remembered because nineteen-year-old me apparently owed him two copper and an explanation.

takes.source_start: Economic progress was difficult to graph.
takes.source_end: Because it made the boy larger.

takes.source_start: Outside, a freight wagon turned toward the southern road.
takes.source_end: The road was not...
